quote: LM performance is often measured with perplexity (PPL) on the held-out dataset sampled from the same distribution (domain) as the training data.

We use different evaluation metrics in different experiments... We quantify their inductive bias... We use perplexity (PPL), the geometric mean of word probabilities across sequences... We report Pearson's correlation coefficients between PPL and the percentage of respective word order in the world.
We use different evaluation metrics in different experiments, but they are all focused on generalization for longer sentences (≥ 9; MEDIUM and LONG sets) than those in the training data.
